Rashi on Nedarim 56b:10:1.hebrew: בצדי השקוף - מבחוץ. מדקאמר עד שיצא מן הבית כולו, אלמא דשקוף נמי הוי בית, ואמאי הנודר מותר מן האגף ולחוץ:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:10:1.english: At the sides of the lintel - From the outside. Since [the Gemara] states, "until he goes out from the entire house," it is evident that [the area beneath] the lintel is also [considered part of] the house; so why is one who vows [not to benefit from a house] permitted [to use the area] from the doorstop and outward?

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:10:2.hebrew: שאני גבי בית וכו' - אבל גבי נדרים מותר מן האגף ולחוץ. שקוף — היינו אסקופה; משקוף — מה שעל הפתח:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:10:2.english: It is different with regard to a house, etc. - But with regard to vows, [he is] permitted from the doorstop and outward. Shkuf — that is the threshold; mashkof — [is] that which is above the doorway.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:1:1.hebrew: המיוחדת - ליתן עליה כלים, והואיל ואין ישנים עליה, אין צריך לכפותה:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:1:1.english: Designated - to place vessels upon it; and since [people] do not sleep upon it, one need not overturn it.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:2:1.hebrew: רבן שמעון אומר אין צריך לזוקפה - אלא הוא, האבל, נוטל קרביטין והיא נופלת:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:2:1.english: Rabban Shimon says: One need not stand it upright - Rather, he — the mourner — removes [its] loops, and it collapses.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:2:3.hebrew: קרביטין מי אית ליה - הכי קים להו דלא הוו להו קרביטין, שאינה עשויה להתפרק, אלא עומדת מוצעת לעולם:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:2:3.english: Does it have loops [karvitin] - Thus it was known to them that they do not have loops, because [such a bed] is not made to be dismantled, but rather stands spread out permanently.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:2:5.hebrew: ערסא דצלא - של עור שישן עליה, אבל אינה חשובה כל כך, ולהכי, הואיל ואינה חשובה, לא היה כופה אלא זוקפה ודיו. והלכך אמרי' במתני' דמותר בדרגש, שאינה מטה חשובה. וערסא דצלא אית לה קרביטין, ופליג רשב"ג בגמרא ואמר דבעי כפיה, כל כך שמתיר קרביטין והעור נופל מאליו, לפי שיש רצועות סביב לעור, ומותחין אותו בין ארוכות המטה, וקושרין הרצועות בארוכות, ושוכבין עליו, וכשמתירין הרצועות והעור נופל — אין לך כפיה גדולה מזו:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:2:5.english: Arsa detzala - [A bed] of leather upon which one sleeps, but it is not so significant; and therefore, since it is not significant, [a mourner] would not overturn it, but rather stand it upright and that suffices for him. And therefore we say in the Mishnah that [one who vows against a bed] is permitted [to use] a dargash, because it is not a significant bed. And a leather bed has loops [karvitin], and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel disagrees in the Gemara and says that it requires overturning, to the extent that one loosens [the] loops and the leather collapses on its own — because there are straps around the leather, and they stretch it between the long rails of the bed, and tie the straps to the rails, and lie upon it; and when one loosens the straps and the leather collapses, you have no greater overturning than this.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:3:1.hebrew: מטה מסרגין אותה על גבה - שכורכין הבגד או העור שישנים עליו סביב אותם עצים שעומדים מראשותיו ומרגלותיו, נקובים, ומכניסין המשיחות שבבגד או שבעור לתוך אותן נקבים:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:3:1.english: A bed — one fastens [the straps] over it - For they wrap the cloth or the leather upon which one sleeps around those wooden [beams] that stand at its head and at its foot, [which are] perforated, and they insert the cords that are in the cloth or in the leather into those holes.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:3:2.hebrew: משישופם בעור הדג - שמשפשף העצים של מטה, הארוכות והקצרות, בעור הדג כדי לעשותן צהובין וחלקים:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:3:2.english: From when he smooths them with the skin of a fish - [This means] that he rubs the wooden [pieces] of the bed, the long and the short [ones], with the skin of a fish in order to make them bright and smooth.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:3:3.english: Why do I [need] smoothing with the skin of a fish - For is not the skin [i.e., the wood] covered by the ropes, or by the cloth, or by the leather?

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:4:1.english: This and that - [They] are laced [with straps] through [the bedframes] themselves.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:4:2.english: To insert and extract through holes - For they insert the ends of the cords on the cloth through the holes [in the bedframe] and tie one to another.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:4:3.hebrew: אעולי ואפוקי באבקתא - שקושרין לו לאות בעצי המטה מראשותיו וממרגלותיו, ומכניסין ראשי משיחות בנקבים וקושרין בלולאות, והיינו קרביטין:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:4:3.english: Inserting and extracting through loops - For they tie loops on the wooden [frame] of the bed at its head and at its foot, and insert the ends of the cords through the holes and tie [them] to the loops, and this is [what is meant by] karvitin.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:5:1.hebrew: שנקליטיה יוצאין - כדאמרי' התם, "נקליטין שנים", ואותה מטה אין אדם יכול לכפותה מפני נקליטיה, אלא זוקפה על ב' מרגלותיה ומניחה, ודיו:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:5:1.english: Whose posts [nakliteha] protrude - As we say there, "[A bed has] two posts [naklitin]," and one cannot overturn that bed because of its posts; rather, he stands it upright on its two foot-posts and leaves it [that way], and that is sufficient for him.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:5:2.english: The halakha is in accordance with Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel] - Who said [that] one unties the straps [karbitin].

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:6:1.english: To its boundary - Within two thousand cubits.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:6:2.hebrew: לעיבורה - היינו פגום נכנס, פגום יוצא של אותה העיר:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:6:2.english: Into its outskirts - That is, an inward recess [or] an outward projection of that city.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:7:1.english: Rather, learn from here that he was standing in its outskirts - and [the verse] calls it "in Jericho".

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:8:1.hebrew: אימא ואפילו בתחומה - הוי בתוך העיר, והאי דכתיב "ויהי בהיות יהושע ביריחו", בתחומה הוה קאי:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:8:1.english: Say, even in its boundary - [it] is [considered] within the city, and [as for] that which is written, "And it came to pass, when Joshua was in Jericho," he was standing in its boundary.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:8:2.hebrew: תחומה אקרי חוץ לעיר, דכתיב "ומדותם מחוץ לעיר":
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:8:2.english: Its boundary is called "outside the city," as it is written: "And you shall measure outside the city."

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:1.hebrew: מן האגף ולפנים - מן סגירת הפתח ולפנים. אגף — כמו (יומא יח.) הגפת דלתות. אבל מן האגף ולחוץ, על עובי המפתן, אינו אסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:1.english: From the doorstop and inward - From the closing of the doorway and inward. "Agaf" [doorstop] is like (Yoma 18a): "closing [haggafat] the doors." However, from the doorstop and outward — on the thickness of the threshold — he is not prohibited.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:2.hebrew: יכול ילך לביתו ויסגיר - ע"י שלוחו:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:2.english: One might [have thought] he may go to his house and quarantine [it] - Through his agent.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:3.hebrew: ת"ל אל פתח הבית - של מנוגע צריך לעמוד:
Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:3.english: The verse states: "To the entrance of the house" - Of [the] afflicted [house] [he] must stand.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:4.english: This is our reading: On the lintel - [That is,] on the thickness of the threshold.

Rashi on Nedarim 56b:9:5.english: Until he goes out from the lintel - For [the area] at the lintel is called "the house."

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:2:1.english: A dargash — one loosens its karvitav [loops], and the leather falls - Karvitav [are] loops that are attached to the bed and tied to the leather:

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:2:2.hebrew: ערסא דצלא - מטה של עור, ותולין רצועות בשפת העור סביב; וכשרוצין לנטותו, עונבים הרצועות בארוכות המטה, וכשמתירין אותם הוא נופל, והם קרביטיו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:2:2.english: Arsa detzala - A bed of leather, and they attach straps around the edge of the leather; and when they wish to set it up, they loop the straps onto the long rails of the bed, and when they untie them, it collapses, and those [straps] are its karvitin.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:3:1.hebrew: מטה - מסרגין הסירוגין על גבה, על הארוכות. הלכך כשכופין אותו, הסירוגין גבוהים ואין יכולין לישב עליו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:3:1.english: A bed - One laces the straps over its top, over the side-rails. Therefore, when one overturns it, the straps are raised up, and one cannot sit on it.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:3:2.hebrew: דרגש סירוגין מבפני' - תחת הארוכות. הלכך כי נמי כופהו, הוא נמוך לישב עליו כאילו אינו כפוי; לכך אמר דאינו צריך לכפותו. ואית דגרסי: איתמר נמי דדרגש אינו בר כפייה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:3:2.english: Dargash — its strapping is from the inside - Underneath the long rails. Therefore, even when one overturns it, it is low [enough] to sit upon, as if it were not overturned; therefore he said that one does not need to overturn it. And there are those who read [the text]: It was also stated that a dargash is not subject to overturning.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:3:3.hebrew: ל"ל שיפת עור הדג - והלא אין יופיו נראה, שהרי הן מכוסות בחבלים המסורגין על גבה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:3:3.english: Why do I [need] smoothing with the skin of a fish? - Is its beauty not unseen, since they are covered by the ropes interlaced over it?

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:4:1.hebrew: בבזייני - בבקעים ובנקבים שבארוכות; מקצת ארוכות מגולות, וצריכה שיפה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:4:1.english: Bevizyanei - Through splits and holes that are in the long side-rails [of the bedframe]; [consequently,] part of the long side-rails are exposed, and [thus the bed] requires smoothing [with fish skin].

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:4:2.hebrew: באבקתא - לולאות, שיש לולאות תלוין בנקבי ארכובותיו, ובהם מכניסין ראשי הרצועות התלויות בשפת העור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:4:2.english: Be'avakta [Through loops] - Loops, for there are loops hanging in the holes of its legs, and into them they insert the ends of the straps that hang from the edge of the leather.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:5:1.english: Whose posts [nakliteha] protrude - [Meaning] that its posts are fixed in the legs of the bed in its usual manner.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:5:2.hebrew: זוקפה - פורס בגד באותן לולאות שבראשי הנקליטין, והוי כאילו כפוי, שאינו ראוי לישיבה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:5:2.english: He stands it - He spreads a cloth over those loops that are at the tops of the bedposts [naklitin], and it is as though [the bed] is overturned, since it is not fit for sitting.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:6:1.hebrew: מותר ליכנס לתחומה - דעד התחום אינו נקרא על שם העיר, אבל עיבור נקרא על שם העיר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:6:1.english: It is permitted to enter its boundary - For [the area] up to the boundary is not called by the name of the city, but the outskirts are called by the name of the city.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:6:2.english: From the doorstop - [This is] the place where the door closes.

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:7:1.english: Rather, learn from here [that he] was standing in its outskirts - And [the verse] calls it "Jericho."

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:8:1.english: "And you shall measure outside the city [...] two thousand cubits" - Thus, [the] boundary is called "outside the city."

Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:9:1.hebrew: יכול ילך לביתו ויסגור - ע"י שליח או על ידי חבל ארוך. תלמוד לומר: "אל פתח הבית". אי "אל פתח הבית", יכול יעמוד תחת המשקוף ויסגיר — דליכא לקיומי בענין אחר, שהרי צריך הוא לצאת מן הבית:
Tosafot on Nedarim 56b:9:1.english: "One might [have thought] he may go to his house and lock [it]" - By means of a messenger or by means of a long rope. "Therefore the verse states: 'to the entrance of the house.' If 'to the entrance of the house,' one might [have thought] he may stand beneath the lintel and quarantine [it]" — for it cannot be fulfilled in any other way, since he must go out from the house.
